name: enable_nestloop
description: Controls whether the query planner considers nested-loop join plans.
symptoms: Suboptimal join performance on large tables
Excessive CPU usage from inefficient nested loops
Slow query execution when hash or merge joins would be faster
Poor scalability with increasing join input sizes
tuning_tips: Disable only if nested-loop joins consistently cause poor performance and alternative join methods (hash/merge) are viable; monitor EXPLAIN output to verify plan changes.
